source: audit/local_gap_osm.py --state MN (audit/local_gap_2026-09-25.json): 56 OSM local-government campgrounds with no entry within 1.5 km
note: First local-gap sweep. All 56 unmatched OSM candidates judged: 26 added as ownership local (13318-13343), 27 excluded, 3 duplicate nodes merged into adds. Two OSM nodes merged into one entry each (Bear Lake + Barnum City Park; the two Cottingham nodes; the Chippewa node and polygon). Amperage is written only where the operator states it. The exclusions are mostly primitive county camps with no published size, canoe or bike camps, and tent-only sites.
